trust_decision.summary: Trust as a fair, self-contained task: the published fix adds Image._decompression_bomb_check at three real image-allocation sinks (BDF per-glyph BBX, PCF metrics table, FontFile.compile's derived packed bitmap), all reachable from public font APIs; the fourth source hunk in FontFile.py is a style-only 'w = w + x' -> 'w += x' rewrite, not a fix.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names BdfFontFile and Image.new() without _decompression_bomb_check(), so an engineer first reads bdf_char, where width/height come from the BBX line (src/PIL/BdfFontFile.py:72) and are passed straight to Image.frombytes (line 85) / Image.new (line 88).

fix_sites.entry_point: FontFile.FontFile.compile(), and its public wrappers FontFile.FontFile.save(filename) (line 129) and FontFile.FontFile.to_imagefont() (line 147)
fix_sites.module_kind: base class / lower-level public API reached only through save and to_imagefont

fix_sites.entry_point: PcfFontFile.PcfFontFile(fp) -> _load_metrics() -> append() (sink then used at src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:224)
fix_sites.module_kind: font file parser plugin (second implementation of FontFile)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: FontFile.compile() only packs glyph boxes the caller already built in memory (self.glyph, src/PIL/FontFile.py:73-84); nothing in FontFile.py parses a font file, so a solver can argue the untrusted-input path ends at the BDF/PCF parsers and the compile()/save()/to_imagefont() sink needs no bomb check.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Zero-area glyphs and empty fonts are legal: bdf_char falls back to Image.new('1', (width, height)) for zero-width characters (src/PIL/BdfFontFile.py:84-88, Tests/test_font_bdf.py:20-24), and compile() must return without a bitmap when xsize==ysize==0 (src/PIL/FontFile.py:86-87) so that save()/to_imagefont() still raise 'No bitmap created' (Tests/test_fontfile.py:33-44); a fix that rejects zero/negative dimensions, or that always allocates a bitmap, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: BDF per-glyph BBX dimensions, one huge glyph (BBX 13378 13378) -> Image.frombytes/Image.new in bdf_char (fix.diff:22-27, fix.diff:100)
PCF jumbo metrics with attacker-chosen left/right and ascent/descent giving huge xsize=right-left and ysize=ascent+descent (fix.diff:58-73, fix.diff:133)
in-memory glyph list whose src box is huge, reaching compile() without any parser (fix.diff:82-86, fix.diff:121)
aggregate shape: many individually-legal glyphs whose packing gives lines*h > limit in compile() (src/PIL/FontFile.py:83-84)
not handled and not needed: PCF compressed metrics (i8-128), bounded to -128..127 (src/PIL/PcfFontFile.py:177-178)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a bomb check on each Image.frombytes((xsize, ysize)) in _load_bitmaps instead of only inside the metrics builder
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the fix guards the metric table that feeds this sink, but a maintainer adding a second bitmap reader or defence-in-depth would naturally check at the allocation itself, as IcoImagePlugin.py:236 does at its sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate check on the zero-width fallback Image.new('1', (width, height)) branch
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the two branches allocate the same attacker-derived size; a maintainer reviewing per-allocation sites (as in GifImagePlugin.py:375-399) could guard this one and not the frombytes above it.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second metrics+bitmap implementation (the documented FIXME 'add support for pilfont2 format') allocating glyph images from its metrics table
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the FIXME records that maintainers intend a second implementation of the same format, and a new parser would need the same bomb check on its own derived sizes.

O10_build.language: Python >= 3.10 plus C extension (src/libImaging, pybind11 custom backend)
O10_build.toolchain: CPython, C compiler, setuptools>=77 + pybind11 custom build backend (pyproject.toml:1-8), optional zlib/libjpeg/libtiff/freetype
O10_build.project_tests: pytest Tests/test_font_bdf.py, Tests/test_font_pcf.py, Tests/test_font_pcf_charsets.py, Tests/test_fontfile.py, Tests/test_imagefontpil.py; test_font_pcf.py is skipped unless the zlib feature is built (Tests/test_font_pcf.py:21)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add Image._decompression_bomb_check only in bdf_char at the BBX parse reproduced from the report and stop there, leaving PcfFontFile._load_metrics and the aggregate (lines*h) bitmap in FontFile.compile() unchecked.

out_of_scope_notes: src/PIL/ImageFont.py:175-178 hands pilfont metrics to the C renderer Image.core.font; its allocation is bounded only by the text extent checked at src/PIL/ImageFont.py:201, and the C side (src/libImaging) was not read.
